sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里，人们发现了一具女性遗体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: At around 6am on Tuesday, March 1, 1994, 16-year-old Aaron Bacon lay sleeping in his bed in the home where he lived with his parents in Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 1994年3月1日，星期二，清晨6点左右，16岁的亚伦·培根正躺在亚利桑那州凤凰城的家中熟睡，那是他与父母同住的地方。

sentences.en: The quiet of the early morning hour was broken by a high-pitched noise outside Aaron's closed bedroom door.
sentences.zh: 清晨的宁静被亚伦紧闭的卧室门外传来的一阵尖锐声响打破。

sentences.en: One of the family's three pet sharpies was whining.
sentences.zh: 家里养的三只沙皮狗中有一只正在呜呜叫。

sentences.en: The sound woke Aaron, and soon he heard their other two dogs start to growl and bark as well.
sentences.zh: 声音惊醒了亚伦，很快他又听到另外两只狗也开始低吼和吠叫。

sentences.en: Aaron's bedroom door suddenly swung open, and three men walked in.
sentences.zh: 亚伦的卧室门突然被推开，三个男人走了进来。

sentences.en: Two of them were strangers who Aaron had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 其中两个是亚伦从未见过的陌生人。

sentences.en: The third was his father.
sentences.zh: 第三个是他的父亲。

sentences.en: As Aaron lay confused and stunned in bed, his father said,
sentences.zh: 当亚伦困惑而震惊地躺在床上时，他的父亲说道：

sentences.en: Aaron, I love you, but we're going to have to make some changes today.
sentences.zh: “亚伦，我爱你，但我们今天必须做出一些改变。”

sentences.en: Sally and Bob Bacon had been worried about their youngest son for some time.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃·培根夫妇为他们的小儿子担心已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: Aaron had always been a bright, talented, and exceptionally empathetic child.
sentences.zh: 亚伦一直是个聪明、有天赋且极其富有同情心的孩子。

sentences.en: When he was little, his mother had discovered that he was making peanut butter sandwiches
sentences.zh: 他小时候，母亲曾发现他会做花生酱三明治，

sentences.en: and leaving them out for unhoused people who lived in the same historic district of Phoenix that they called home.
sentences.zh: 然后留给住在他们凤凰城历史街区里的无家可归者。

sentences.en: He stood up for kids at school who were being bullied, and he was passionate about music and writing poetry.
sentences.zh: 他在学校里会为被欺负的孩子出头，并且对音乐和写诗充满热情。

sentences.en: But things had slowly started to change when Aaron was in the eighth grade.
sentences.zh: 但当亚伦上八年级时，情况开始慢慢发生变化。

sentences.en: The problems began when his brother Jared, three years older than Aaron, and the only other child of Sally and Bob Bacon, began experimenting with recreational drugs.
sentences.zh: 问题始于他的哥哥贾里德——比亚伦大三岁，也是莎莉和鲍勃·培根夫妇唯一的另一个孩子——开始尝试娱乐性毒品。

sentences.en: Aaron was unhappy about this.
sentences.zh: 亚伦对此很不高兴。

sentences.en: His father, Bob, was a recovering alcoholic.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲鲍勃曾是一名酗酒者，正在戒酒中。

sentences.en: By 1994, he had been sober for eight and a half years and was doing well, with a thriving career as an architect and a designer.
sentences.zh: 到1994年，他已经戒酒八年半，生活步入正轨，作为一名建筑师和设计师，事业蒸蒸日上。

sentences.en: Bob had always been very upfront with his sons about this, teaching them about the dangers of addiction.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃一直对儿子们非常坦诚，教导他们关于毒瘾的危害。

sentences.en: Yet, when Jared started using drugs, neither Bob nor Sally confronted him about it, which upset Aaron.
sentences.zh: 然而，当贾里德开始吸毒时，鲍勃和莎莉都没有去质问他，这让亚伦感到不安。

sentences.en: Jared eventually asked his mother for help, and his parents sent them to a respected rehab facility in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 贾里德最终向母亲求助，父母将他送往明尼苏达州一家受人尊敬的康复中心。

sentences.en: The experience didn't seem to change Jared's behaviour, and he continued to smoke cannabis after leaving the facility.
sentences.zh: 这段经历似乎并没有改变贾里德的行为，他在离开中心后继续吸食大麻。

sentences.en: He eventually stopped using drugs on his own a few years later.
sentences.zh: 几年后，他最终靠自己停止了吸毒。

sentences.en: But six months after Jared had entered rehab,
sentences.zh: 但在贾里德进入康复中心六个月后，

sentences.en: Aaron began to experiment for himself.
sentences.zh: 亚伦开始自己尝试毒品。

sentences.en: He started smoking cannabis and taking psychedelics.
sentences.zh: 他开始吸食大麻并服用迷幻药。

sentences.en: Aaron had always been a top student, but his grades began to drop.
sentences.zh: 亚伦一直是个优等生，但他的成绩开始下滑。

sentences.en: He campaigned to be allowed to change schools, leaving the exclusive private school he attended for a public one called Central High.
sentences.zh: 他极力要求转学，离开了他就读的贵族私立学校，转入了一所名为中央高中的公立学校。

sentences.en: Aaron told his parents he felt stifled by his current school and wanted to study somewhere with a more diverse student body.
sentences.zh: 亚伦告诉父母，他觉得现在的学校让他感到压抑，想去一个学生群体更多元化的地方学习。

sentences.en: His girlfriend also attended Central High, adding to its appeal.
sentences.zh: 他的女朋友也在中央高中上学，这增加了学校对他的吸引力。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob had agreed, but were disappointed when the switch didn't seem to make Aaron any happier or more settled.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃同意了，但令他们失望的是，转学似乎并没有让亚伦变得更快乐或更稳定。

sentences.en: In fact, his behaviour grew worse.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他的行为变得更糟了。

sentences.en: He would take the family car out at night without permission, getting into minor scrapes and later denying it when his parents noticed the damage.
sentences.zh: 他会在晚上未经允许开走家里的车，造成轻微剐蹭，后来当父母发现损坏时，他又矢口否认。

sentences.en: Aaron was increasingly withdrawn and irritable, no longer confiding in his mother as he once had.
sentences.zh: 亚伦变得越来越孤僻和易怒，不再像以前那样向母亲吐露心声。

sentences.en: The final straw came in February of 1994, when Aaron was attacked by members of a street gang in his school parking lot.
sentences.zh: 最后一根稻草出现在1994年2月，当时亚伦在学校停车场被一个街头帮派的成员袭击了。

sentences.en: Witnesses to the assault said that it didn't appear to be a random incident.
sentences.zh: 袭击的目击者称，这看起来并非随机事件。

sentences.en: It looked like the gang members knew Aaron.
sentences.zh: 看起来帮派成员认识亚伦。

sentences.en: They had called him Rabbit, a nickname that suggested familiarity.
sentences.zh: 他们叫他“兔子”，这个绰号暗示了他们之间很熟悉。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob wondered if Aaron was in fact an associate of the gang.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃怀疑亚伦实际上是该帮派的成员。

sentences.en: He was now smoking pot regularly.
sentences.zh: 他现在经常吸食大麻。

sentences.en: What if the attack had been drug-related?
sentences.zh: 如果袭击与毒品有关呢？

sentences.en: Concerned that their youngest son might have escalated from taking drugs to selling them,
sentences.zh: 担心他们的小儿子可能已经从吸毒升级到贩毒，

sentences.en: Sally and Bob knew they had to do something as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃知道他们必须尽快采取行动。

sentences.en: They pulled Aaron out of school and considered their options.
sentences.zh: 他们让亚伦退了学，并考虑了各种选择。

sentences.en: They were already in family therapy, which they'd started after Aaron started stealing their car.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在进行家庭治疗，这是在亚伦开始偷他们的车之后开始的。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob did not want to send Aaron to a rehab facility as they had with their oldest son.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃不想像对待大儿子那样把亚伦送进康复中心。

sentences.en: Sally had realised that the reason the facility hadn't helped Jared was likely because he didn't have an actual addiction.
sentences.zh: 莎莉意识到，康复中心之所以没能帮助贾里德，很可能是因为他并没有真正的毒瘾。

sentences.en: The same was true for Aaron.
sentences.zh: 亚伦的情况也是如此。

sentences.en: He just needed some guidance to set him on a better course.
sentences.zh: 他只是需要一些指导来让他走上正轨。

sentences.en: Then Sally remembered something she'd heard about from a friend.
sentences.zh: 这时，莎莉想起了一位朋友提到过的事情。

sentences.en: Her friend had told her about a wilderness therapy camp designed especially for troubled teens, located in the southern region of Utah.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友曾告诉她一个专门为问题少年设计的荒野疗法营地，位于犹他州南部地区。

sentences.en: Sally's friend knew a couple who had sent their rebellious son there, and he'd reportedly emerged with a wonderful new attitude.
sentences.zh: 莎莉的朋友认识一对夫妇，他们把叛逆的儿子送到了那里，据报道，他回来时态度有了极好的转变。

sentences.en: North Star had been founded four years earlier by a former military policeman named Lance Jagger.
sentences.zh: “北极星”是由一名前军事警察兰斯·贾格尔在四年前创立的。

sentences.en: It was one of many such camps that had sprung up in Utah and other western United States during the 1980s and 90s.
sentences.zh: 这是20世纪80年代和90年代在犹他州及美国西部其他地区涌现出的众多此类营地之一。

sentences.en: In fact, it was estimated that there were roughly 115 organisations that offered wilderness programs designed to assist so-called troubled youths across the entire country.
sentences.zh: 事实上，据估计，全国大约有115个组织提供旨在帮助所谓“问题少年”的荒野项目。

sentences.en: Away from televisions, computer games, and friends deemed to be a bad influence,
sentences.zh: 远离电视、电脑游戏和被认为有不良影响的朋友，

sentences.en: teenagers who attended these programs could reconnect with the natural world via long, difficult hikes and sleeping outside.
sentences.zh: 参加这些项目的青少年可以通过漫长而艰苦的徒步旅行和露天睡眠与自然世界重新建立联系。

sentences.en: They were taught outdoor survival skills, such as starting a fire with no matches, as a way to improve their discipline and self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 他们被教导户外生存技能，例如在没有火柴的情况下生火，以此来提高他们的纪律性和自尊心。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob Bacon were intrigued by the idea of wilderness therapy.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃·培根对荒野疗法的想法很感兴趣。

sentences.en: They called North Star Expeditions and asked for a brochure.
sentences.zh: 他们致电“北极星探险”并索要了宣传册。

sentences.en: North Star's base camp was located in the small Utah town of Escalante, which, in 1994, was home to less than 1,000 people.
sentences.zh: “北极星”的基地营地位于犹他州埃斯卡兰特小镇，1994年时，那里的人口不足1000人。

sentences.en: Situated in the south-central part of the state, on the scenic Utah Byway, it was also home to stunning natural scenery.
sentences.zh: 它位于该州中南部，坐落在风景优美的犹他州公路上，拥有令人惊叹的自然风光。

sentences.en: Red rock canyons and sprawling deserts surrounded the town.
sentences.zh: 红岩峡谷和广袤的沙漠环绕着这个小镇。

sentences.en: There were four phases to North Star's 63-day program.
sentences.zh: “北极星”的63天项目分为四个阶段。

sentences.en: A-Team was the first phase, an orientation portion for new arrivals.
sentences.zh: “A队”是第一阶段，是为新来者准备的适应期。

sentences.en: Then, they graduated to Primitive, where they were transported out to the Escalante River Basin and provided with backpacks, sleeping bags, and clothing.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们会晋升到“原始”阶段，被送往埃斯卡兰特河流域，并配发背包、睡袋和衣物。

sentences.en: This phase began with a 48-hour fast, after which attendees were given a week's worth of food supplies.
sentences.zh: 这一阶段以48小时禁食开始，之后参与者会获得一周的食物补给。

sentences.en: They had to cook their food themselves, and it mostly consisted of rice, lentils, oatmeal, as well as some vegetables and proteins.
sentences.zh: 他们必须自己做饭，食物主要包括米饭、扁豆、燕麦片，以及一些蔬菜和蛋白质。

sentences.en: Next came the hand-carts phase, where teens would learn to work together as a team.
sentences.zh: 接下来是“手推车”阶段，青少年们将学习如何团队协作。

sentences.en: The final phase was llamas, which taught care for animals and prepared the youths for their return home.
sentences.zh: 最后阶段是“美洲驼”，教授动物护理，并为青少年回家做准备。

sentences.en: After reading about the company and its many success stories, the Bacons spoke with North Star representatives over the phone.
sentences.zh: 在阅读了关于该公司及其众多成功案例的资料后，培根夫妇通过电话与“北极星”的代表进行了交谈。

sentences.en: They were told that the campers hiked for around 8-10 hours a day, then sat by a campfire at night, writing in their journals and chatting about their issues with trained experts.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知，营员们每天徒步约8到10小时，晚上坐在篝火旁，在日记中写作，并与训练有素的专家交流他们的问题。

sentences.en: Sally Bacon thought this sounded perfect for Aaron.
sentences.zh: 莎莉·培根认为这听起来非常适合亚伦。

sentences.en: He was a thoughtful, introspective boy who was content being alone and loved to write.
sentences.zh: 他是一个善于思考、内省的男孩，喜欢独处，也热爱写作。

sentences.en: Sally could picture him sitting by a fire, scribbling away and having plenty of time for reflection while surrounded by stunning scenery.
sentences.zh: 莎莉可以想象他坐在火堆旁，奋笔疾书，在迷人的风景中拥有充足的时间进行反思。

sentences.en: It almost sounded like it would be a vacation for him.
sentences.zh: 这听起来几乎像是他的度假。

sentences.en: The Bacons were given a list of names of parents whom they could call to ask about their own children's experiences at the camp.
sentences.zh: 培根夫妇得到了一份家长名单，他们可以打电话询问这些家长关于孩子在营地的经历。

sentences.en: Sally also ran the idea by their family therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 莎莉还把这个想法告诉了他们的家庭治疗师。

sentences.en: Every person Sally spoke with was in favour of Aaron attending North Star.
sentences.zh: 莎莉交谈过的每一个人都赞成亚伦参加“北极星”。

sentences.en: Convinced that North Star sounded like the right fit for Aaron,
sentences.zh: 确信“北极星”听起来是亚伦的合适选择，

sentences.en: Sally and Bob decided to proceed.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃决定继续推进。

sentences.en: It wasn't going to be cheap.
sentences.zh: 这并不便宜。

sentences.en: The program cost $13,900 and also charged for interstate transportation as Aaron would be travelling over from Arizona.
sentences.zh: 该项目费用为13,900美元，还收取州际交通费，因为亚伦将从亚利桑那州赶来。

sentences.en: North Star also said that for an extra $775, one of the organisation's owners, Lance Jagger, would fly to Phoenix and personally escort Aaron to the camp.
sentences.zh: “北极星”还表示，只要额外支付775美元，该组织的创始人之一兰斯·贾格尔就会飞往凤凰城，亲自护送亚伦前往营地。

sentences.en: They recommended this approach over parents bringing their child to North Star, as it would set the new tone for the troubled teen from the get-go
sentences.zh: 他们建议采用这种方式，而不是由父母带孩子去“北极星”，因为这能从一开始就为问题少年定下基调，

sentences.en: and prevent unpleasant family fights.
sentences.zh: 并防止不愉快的家庭争吵。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob agreed and took out a second mortgage on their home to fund the costs.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃同意了，并为支付费用将房子进行了二次抵押。

sentences.en: The day before Aaron was due to be taken to Utah, the couple met with Lance Jagger and his wife Barbara at a hotel in Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 在亚伦被带往犹他州的前一天，夫妇俩在凤凰城的一家酒店会见了兰斯·贾格尔和他的妻子芭芭拉。

sentences.en: The four had a long meeting to discuss the finer details of the plan.
sentences.zh: 四人进行了长时间的会议，讨论计划的细节。

sentences.en: Sally also wanted to voice some final concerns.
sentences.zh: 莎莉还想表达最后的一些担忧。

sentences.en: Aaron was tall at just under 6 feet and thin, weighing 131 pounds or roughly 59 kilograMs.
sentences.zh: 亚伦身高不到6英尺，身材瘦削，体重131磅，约59公斤。

sentences.en: Sally was worried that the program, which saw teenagers receive fairly basic food, might lead to him shedding weight he couldn't afford to lose.
sentences.zh: 莎莉担心这个项目只提供相当基础的食物，可能会导致他体重下降，而他已经经不起再瘦了。

sentences.en: Barbara reassured Sally that they would never let any of their campers lose weight.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉向莎莉保证，他们绝不会让任何营员体重减轻。

sentences.en: Sally wanted to know what the protocol was when a teenager made a complaint.
sentences.zh: 莎莉想知道当青少年提出投诉时，协议是什么。

sentences.en: What if, for example, a camper reported that they had been sexually abused by one of the camp leaders?
sentences.zh: 例如，如果一名营员报告说他受到了营地领导之一的性虐待，该怎么办？

sentences.en: How would North Star handle that?
sentences.zh: “北极星”会如何处理？

sentences.en: Lance and Barbara explained that if a child made a complaint, someone from the North Star office would be immediately dispatched
sentences.zh: 兰斯和芭芭拉解释说，如果孩子提出投诉，来自“北极星”办公室的人员会立即被派往

sentences.en: to the location where the teens were camping to investigate the matter.
sentences.zh: 青少年露营的地点调查此事。

sentences.en: But the Bacons wouldn't need to worry, because Aaron would be well cared for.
sentences.zh: 但培根夫妇不必担心，因为亚伦会得到很好的照顾。

sentences.en: His days would be spent in some of the most beautiful locations in the western United States and there would be therapists on hand for him to talk through his issues with.
sentences.zh: 他每天都会待在美国西部最美丽的地方，而且会有治疗师在场，让他倾诉自己的问题。

sentences.en: Bob warned that Aaron wasn't the type of person who responded well to threats or intimidation tactics.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃警告说，亚伦不是那种对威胁或恐吓手段有良好反应的人。

sentences.en: A hostile approach wouldn't work on him.
sentences.zh: 敌对的态度对他不起作用。

sentences.en: Lance told Bob not to worry, stating,
sentences.zh: 兰斯告诉鲍勃不用担心，并说道：

sentences.en: Early the next morning, Lance Jagger and a colleague arrived at the Bacon residence to collect Aaron.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，兰斯·贾格尔和一名同事抵达培根家接亚伦。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob had mentioned North Star as a possibility to Aaron, but the unannounced and somewhat aggressive collection process totally shocked him.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃曾向亚伦提过“北极星”的可能性，但这种不打招呼且带有某种侵略性的接人过程让他彻底震惊了。

sentences.en: As Aaron still lay in bed, his father explained that the other two men in his room were there to help and he wanted Aaron to go with them.
sentences.zh: 当亚伦还躺在床上时，他的父亲解释说房间里的另外两个男人是来帮忙的，他希望亚伦跟他们走。

sentences.en: Aaron started to get up when one of the two men reached out and roughly grabbed his arm.
sentences.zh: 亚伦刚要起身，其中一个男人就伸出手，粗暴地抓住了他的手臂。

sentences.en: He was large and weighed almost twice as much as the scrawny 16-year-old.
sentences.zh: 他身材魁梧，体重几乎是这个瘦弱的16岁少年的两倍。

sentences.en: Aaron tried to slip out of his grasp, prompting the man to take hold of Aaron's shoulders and push him back down on the bed.
sentences.zh: 亚伦试图挣脱，那人便抓住亚伦的肩膀，将他按回床上。

sentences.en: You're coming with me, he said.
sentences.zh: “你得跟我走，”他说。

sentences.en: If I detect any resistance, I'll assume you are trying to get away and I'll take the appropriate action.
sentences.zh: “如果我发现你有任何反抗，我会认为你在试图逃跑，并采取相应的行动。”

sentences.en: Do I make myself clear?
sentences.zh: “我说明白了吗？”

sentences.en: When Aaron was escorted from his bedroom, flanked by Lance and his co-worker,
sentences.zh: 当亚伦在兰斯和同事的夹持下被带出卧室时，

sentences.en: Sally could see how scared he looked.
sentences.zh: 莎莉能看出他有多害怕。

sentences.en: She moved to hug him goodbye, but Lance didn't allow Aaron to hug his mother back.
sentences.zh: 她想拥抱他告别，但兰斯不允许亚伦回抱母亲。

sentences.en: Sally kissed Aaron on the cheek and said I love you.
sentences.zh: 莎莉亲吻了亚伦的脸颊，说：“我爱你。”

sentences.en: Aaron was silent.
sentences.zh: 亚伦沉默不语。

sentences.en: After he left the home, driven away to the airport by his handlers, Bob began to cry.
sentences.zh: 在他离开家，被看管人开车送往机场后，鲍勃开始哭泣。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob weren't allowed to talk to Aaron while he was at North Star.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和鲍勃在亚伦参加“北极星”期间不允许与他通话。

sentences.en: They were permitted to call the head office once a week for a report on Aaron's progress.
sentences.zh: 他们被允许每周给总部打一次电话，询问亚伦的进展报告。

sentences.en: Sally typically called and would speak to either Barbara Jagger or another staff member named Daryl Bartholomew.
sentences.zh: 莎莉通常会打电话给芭芭拉·贾格尔或另一位名叫达里尔·巴塞洛缪的员工。

sentences.en: They always told her things were fine, though Aaron was rebelling somewhat.
sentences.zh: 他们总是告诉她一切都好，尽管亚伦有些反抗。

sentences.en: Barbara said he'd tried to manipulate her, while Daryl described him as belligerent and a whiner who was refusing to carry his pack on hikes.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉说他试图操纵她，而达里尔则形容他是个好战且爱抱怨的人，拒绝在徒步时背负自己的背包。

sentences.en: The other kids in the program didn't like him.
sentences.zh: 项目里的其他孩子也不喜欢他。

sentences.en: These descriptions didn't sound like Aaron as far as Sally was concerned,
sentences.zh: 在莎莉看来，这些描述听起来不像亚伦，

sentences.en: but she rationalised it by telling herself the program coordinators were likely jaded from their experience working with teenagers who really were manipulative.
sentences.zh: 但她通过告诉自己项目协调员可能因为与真正具有操纵性的青少年打交道而变得麻木，从而合理化了这些说法。

sentences.en: Several weeks passed.
sentences.zh: 几周过去了。

sentences.en: One day, Sally received a call from North Star asking her a question.
sentences.zh: 一天，莎莉接到“北极星”打来的电话，问了她一个问题。

sentences.en: Was it true she had a rare form of epilepsy that could sometimes cause loss of bowel control?
sentences.zh: 她是否患有一种罕见的癫痫症，有时会导致大小便失禁？

sentences.en: Sally affirmed that this was true and asked why they wanted to know.
sentences.zh: 莎莉肯定了这一点，并询问他们为什么要问这个。

sentences.en: The staff member told her that Aaron had soiled himself and told his camp counsellors about his mother's condition.
sentences.zh: 工作人员告诉她，亚伦弄脏了裤子，并告诉营地辅导员他母亲的情况。

sentences.en: He said he was worried that he might have inherited it.
sentences.zh: 他说他担心自己可能遗传了这种病。

sentences.en: This alarmed Sally.
sentences.zh: 这让莎莉感到惊慌。

sentences.en: She told the staff member that had never happened before and Aaron had shown no signs of having epilepsy.
sentences.zh: 她告诉工作人员，这种情况以前从未发生过，亚伦也没有表现出任何患有癫痫的迹象。

sentences.en: She couldn't understand why he would soil himself, which was something that hadn't happened since he was an infant.
sentences.zh: 她无法理解他为什么会弄脏裤子，这在他婴儿时期之后就再没发生过了。

sentences.en: The staff member reassured her that nothing was really wrong with Aaron.
sentences.zh: 工作人员向她保证，亚伦并没有什么大碍。

sentences.en: Teenagers in the program pulled stunts like that all the time.
sentences.zh: 项目里的青少年经常搞这种把戏。

sentences.en: Sometimes, if they were hiking and not permitted to stop to go to the bathroom, they would soil themselves to make a statement.
sentences.zh: 有时，如果他们在徒步旅行中不被允许停下来上厕所，他们会弄脏裤子来表达不满。

sentences.en: Sally was confused.
sentences.zh: 莎莉感到困惑。

sentences.en: She asked why they wouldn't just be allowed to use the bathroom in the first place, but was merely told it wasn't always possible if they were trekking up a hill.
sentences.zh: 她问为什么不直接允许他们上厕所，但得到的回答仅仅是如果他们在爬山，这并不总是可能的。

sentences.en: On the evening of Wednesday March 30, Sally called Northstar for another progress update.
sentences.zh: 3月30日星期三晚上，莎莉致电“北极星”询问进一步的进展。

sentences.en: Aaron was nearing the end of one month at the camp.
sentences.zh: 亚伦在营地的第一个月即将结束。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the news wasn't positive.
sentences.zh: 很遗憾，消息并不乐观。

sentences.en: Daryl Bartholomew told Sally that Aaron wasn't cooperating with them and was trying to obtain other kids' food, despite having his own to eat.
sentences.zh: 达里尔·巴塞洛缪告诉莎莉，亚伦不仅不配合他们，还试图抢夺其他孩子的食物，尽管他自己也有份。

sentences.en: His attitude was so poor that he'd have to repeat the program.
sentences.zh: 他的态度非常恶劣，以至于必须重修这个项目。

sentences.en: Distraught by this news, Sally went to bed crying that night.
sentences.zh: 听到这个消息，莎莉心烦意乱，那天晚上哭着睡着了。

sentences.en: As she lay there, she prayed that things would improve for Aaron.
sentences.zh: 躺在床上时，她祈祷亚伦的情况能有所好转。

sentences.en: The following day, Sally was driving when she received a notification on her pager to call Northstar.
sentences.zh: 第二天，莎莉在开车时收到传呼机发来的通知，让她给北极星组织打电话。

sentences.en: When she arrived home, she phoned the organization's head office and spoke to Barbara Jagger.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，她拨通了该组织总部的电话，与芭芭拉·贾格尔进行了交谈。

sentences.en: Aaron is down.
sentences.zh: 亚伦倒下了。

sentences.en: We can't get a pulse, Barbara told her.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉告诉她，他们测不到亚伦的脉搏了。

sentences.en: Sally didn't understand what Barbara was saying.
sentences.zh: 莎莉没听懂芭芭拉在说什么。

sentences.en: When she asked what that meant, Barbara explained that Aaron had been airlifted to a hospital in Page, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 当她询问这是什么意思时，芭芭拉解释说，亚伦已经被空运到了亚利桑那州佩奇市的一家医院。

sentences.en: Sally should call her husband, Bob, as he'd already been notified and had the hospital's number.
sentences.zh: 莎莉应该给她的丈夫鲍勃打电话，因为他已经接到通知，并且有医院的电话号码。

sentences.en: Sally immediately called her husband at work.
sentences.zh: 莎莉立即给正在上班的丈夫打了电话。

sentences.en: He sounded numb and spoke directly, telling Sally that apparently there had been some sort of freak accident at the camp.
sentences.zh: 他的声音听起来麻木而直接，告诉莎莉营地似乎发生了一场离奇的意外。

sentences.en: Aaron had collapsed, possibly after eating something poisonous.
sentences.zh: 亚伦晕倒了，可能是因为吃了什么有毒的东西。

sentences.en: Camp leaders had done all they could to revive him, but nothing had worked.
sentences.zh: 营地负责人尽了全力抢救，但都无济于事。

sentences.en: Aaron was dead.
sentences.zh: 亚伦死了。

sentences.en: Three days later, Aaron's remains arrived at a mortuary in Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 三天后，亚伦的遗体被送到了凤凰城的一家殡仪馆。

sentences.en: The devastated and shocked Sally and Bob went there to identify him.
sentences.zh: 悲痛欲绝且震惊不已的莎莉和鲍勃前往那里认尸。

sentences.en: As the sheet was removed from Aaron's body, Sally covered her eyes and began to scream.
sentences.zh: 当亚伦身上的白布被掀开时，莎莉捂住双眼，开始尖叫。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 支持我们的赞助商，就是支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: When Aaron Bacon first arrived at Northstar's base camp, he was strip-searched and given a medical exam.
sentences.zh: 亚伦·培根刚到达北极星基地营地时，就被搜身并接受了体检。

sentences.en: Blood and urine tests revealed he had traces of cannabis in his system, but there was nothing else of concern.
sentences.zh: 血液和尿液检测显示他的体内有大麻残留，但没有其他令人担忧的问题。

sentences.en: Staff members shaved off Aaron's long hair and provided him with clothing, including a hooded sweatshirt, three shirts, three pairs of cotton pants, socks, underwear,
sentences.zh: 工作人员剃光了亚伦的长发，并给了他一些衣物，包括一件连帽衫、三件衬衫、三条棉裤、袜子、内衣，

sentences.en: and a pair of cheap hiking boots that were two sizes too small.
sentences.zh: 以及一双小了两个尺码的廉价登山靴。

sentences.en: He was also given a journal.
sentences.zh: 他还得到了一本日志。

sentences.en: All Northstar participants had to write in their journals daily, as well as compose an essay outlining what they had done to be sent there.
sentences.zh: 所有北极星的参与者都必须每天写日志，并写一篇作文，概述他们做了什么才被送到这里。

sentences.en: Everything the teenagers wrote was read by Northstar's staff members, including letters home to loved ones.
sentences.zh: 青少年写的一切内容都会被北极星的工作人员阅读，包括写给亲人的家书。

sentences.en: In Aaron's essay, he expressed his belief that his parents were making a mistake by sending him to Northstar.
sentences.zh: 在亚伦的作文中，他表达了自己的看法，认为父母把他送到北极星是一个错误。

sentences.en: Quote, If I am forced to change, this program seems ready to force me.
sentences.zh: 引用如下：“如果我被迫改变，这个项目似乎准备强迫我。”

sentences.en: This is not my parents' last resort.
sentences.zh: “这不是我父母的最后手段。”

sentences.en: Child abuse, which I think this program is, is never a resort.
sentences.zh: “虐待儿童——我认为这个项目就是虐待——绝不是一种手段。”

sentences.en: It only results in the opposite.
sentences.zh: “它只会适得其反。”

sentences.en: Aaron clashed with Northstar's owner, Lance Jagger, whose rough, hewn style was the opposite of Aaron's more intellectual personality.
sentences.zh: 亚伦与北极星的老板兰斯·贾格尔发生了冲突，兰斯粗犷、生硬的风格与亚伦较为知性的性格截然相反。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Aaron soon tried to adopt a more positive approach.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，亚伦很快还是尝试采取更积极的态度。

sentences.en: He apologised to Lance's wife Barbara for being rude when they first met, explaining that he didn't usually behave that way,
sentences.zh: 他为初次见面时的无礼向兰斯的妻子芭芭拉道歉，解释说他平时不会那样做，

sentences.en: but he'd been angry about the situation he found himself in.
sentences.zh: 但他对自己所处的境地感到愤怒。

sentences.en: His apology was rejected by Barbara,
sentences.zh: 他的道歉遭到了芭芭拉的拒绝。

sentences.en: Aaron and five other new arrivals soon started the first phase of the program,
sentences.zh: 亚伦和其他五名新成员很快开始了项目的第一阶段，

sentences.en: A-Team.
sentences.zh: 即“A队”。

sentences.en: Designed to help the teenagers acclimatise to both their physical surroundings and the program's style,
sentences.zh: “A队”旨在帮助青少年适应周围的物理环境和项目的风格，

sentences.en: A-Team involved camping in the wilderness for 10 days.
sentences.zh: 包括在荒野中露营10天。

sentences.en: They were driven out to the desert to stay in rough terrain at 5,600 feet elevation.
sentences.zh: 他们被带到沙漠中，住在海拔5600英尺的崎岖地形上。

sentences.en: In March, the temperature during the day was chilly, and it dropped to below freezing at night.
sentences.zh: 三月份，白天的气温很冷，晚上则降至冰点以下。

sentences.en: All participants were given a backpack that they had to keep all their provisions in, including a sleeping bag.
sentences.zh: 所有参与者都发了一个背包，他们必须把所有的补给品都放在里面，包括睡袋。

sentences.en: Aaron, who was used to the warmer weather in Phoenix, struggled with the freezing cold climate.
sentences.zh: 习惯了凤凰城温暖天气的亚伦，在严寒的气候中挣扎。

sentences.en: The clothes he'd been given weren't warm enough, and he described shaking uncontrollably from his arrival on.
sentences.zh: 他得到的衣服不够保暖，他形容自己从到达起就一直在无法控制地发抖。

sentences.en: A few days into A-Team, Aaron's stomach started to hurt badly, and he had problems with his bowel movements.
sentences.zh: 进入“A队”几天后，亚伦的胃开始剧烈疼痛，排便也出现了问题。

sentences.en: He was also hungry and craving a proper meal.
sentences.zh: 他还感到饥饿，渴望吃上一顿正餐。

sentences.en: Most of the rations he was given, such as oatmeal and lentils, had to be cooked over an open fire.
sentences.zh: 他得到的大部分口粮，如燕麦片和扁豆，都必须在露天火堆上烹饪。

sentences.en: The teens were each responsible for cooking their own meals and had to learn to light their own fires
sentences.zh: 青少年们每个人都要负责烹饪自己的饭菜，并且必须学会生火，

sentences.en: using a Native American technique in which a piece of wood was inserted into a socket drilled in another piece of wood and spun quickly.
sentences.zh: 使用的是一种美洲原住民的技术，即将一根木棍插入另一块木头上钻出的孔中，然后快速旋转。

sentences.en: If a student failed to light their own fire, they weren't allowed to use another teenager's fire or sit by one to stay warm.
sentences.zh: 如果学员没能生起火，就不允许使用其他青少年的火，也不能坐在火边取暖。

sentences.en: Aaron struggled to learn the technique and was unable to start a fire.
sentences.zh: 亚伦努力学习这种技术，但没能生起火。

sentences.en: Consequently, he often went hungry.
sentences.zh: 因此，他经常挨饿。

sentences.en: Despite not mastering fire starting, Aaron was moved into the second phase of the program, called Primitive.
sentences.zh: 尽管没有掌握生火技术，亚伦还是被调到了项目的第二阶段，即“原始”阶段。

sentences.en: This involved a gruelling six-week hike.
sentences.zh: 这包括一次艰苦的六周徒步旅行。

sentences.en: Aaron's group of six teenagers was led by three camp counsellors employed by North Star,
sentences.zh: 亚伦所在的六人青少年小组由北极星雇佣的三名营地辅导员带领，

sentences.en: 19-year-old Craig Fisher, 20-year-old Sonny Duncan, and 21-year-old Jeff Hohenstein.
sentences.zh: 分别是19岁的克雷格·费舍尔、20岁的桑尼·邓肯和21岁的杰夫·霍恩斯坦。

sentences.en: Only two counsellors stayed with the group at any given time, with the three young men rotating shifts to take turns.
sentences.zh: 任何时候只有两名辅导员与小组在一起，这三名年轻人轮流值班。

sentences.en: Primitive began with the teens undertaking a 48-hour fast, while simultaneously trekking through rough terrain.
sentences.zh: “原始”阶段开始时，青少年们要进行48小时的禁食，同时在崎岖的地形中跋涉。

sentences.en: Aaron, who still had an intense stomach ache, wrote of how bad he felt.
sentences.zh: 亚伦仍然胃痛难忍，他在日志中写下了自己的感受有多糟糕。

sentences.en: But he tried to put a positive spin on things, noting that the next couple of weeks would both test my physical limitations and broaden them.
sentences.zh: 但他试图往好的方面想，写道：“接下来的几周既会考验我的身体极限，也会拓宽它们。”

sentences.en: The hiking was difficult.
sentences.zh: 徒步旅行非常困难。

sentences.en: It involved lots of clambering across sharp rocks and steep cliffs.
sentences.zh: 涉及大量在尖锐的岩石和陡峭的悬崖上攀爬。

sentences.en: As Aaron's boots were too small for his feet, he began to develop painful blisters.
sentences.zh: 由于亚伦的靴子太小，他的脚开始长出痛苦的水泡。

sentences.en: Under the weight of his 45-pound or 20-kilo backpack, he also started to trip and fall.
sentences.zh: 在45磅（约20公斤）重的背包重压下，他也开始跌跌撞撞。

sentences.en: After the first fall, Aaron struggled to regain his feet due to the weight of the pack.
sentences.zh: 第一次摔倒后，由于背包太重，亚伦挣扎着想站起来。

sentences.en: He eventually managed, but soon fell again.
sentences.zh: 他最终成功了，但很快又摔倒了。

sentences.en: His legs felt weak like jelly.
sentences.zh: 他的腿感觉像果冻一样无力。

sentences.en: After this second fall, his entire body was numb and he couldn't lift his arMs.
sentences.zh: 第二次摔倒后，他全身麻木，连胳膊都抬不起来。

sentences.en: When Aaron reported these issues to his counsellors, they dismissed Aaron's complaints, believing he was feigning discomfort and pain to get out of the program.
sentences.zh: 当亚伦向辅导员报告这些问题时，他们驳回了亚伦的抱怨，认为他是在装病装痛，想逃避项目。

sentences.en: They told him to stop being lazy.
sentences.zh: 他们让他别再偷懒了。

sentences.en: The more Aaron complained about feeling sick and dizzy, the more harshly he was criticised.
sentences.zh: 亚伦抱怨自己感到恶心和头晕的次数越多，受到的批评就越严厉。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before some of the other teens and even the counsellors were calling him gay, using the word as a derogatory slur to imply Aaron was weak and not masculine enough.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，一些其他的青少年甚至辅导员都开始叫他“同性恋”，用这个词作为贬义的侮辱，暗示亚伦软弱，不够阳刚。

sentences.en: On Sunday, March 13, two days into the hike, the group was permitted to break their faSt.
sentences.zh: 3月13日星期日，徒步旅行的第二天，小组被允许结束禁食。

sentences.en: All of the teenagers were given a can of peaches.
sentences.zh: 所有的青少年都得到了一罐桃子。

sentences.en: But during the hike that day, Aaron continued to trip and fall.
sentences.zh: 但在那天徒步旅行期间，亚伦继续跌跌撞撞。

sentences.en: At one stage, when he tried to climb through a canyon, he slipped and hid his chin on a rock, cutting it open.
sentences.zh: 有一次，当他试图爬过峡谷时，他滑倒了，下巴磕在石头上，划开了一道口子。

sentences.en: Aaron wrote in his journal,
sentences.zh: 亚伦在日志中写道，

sentences.en: After this, Aaron started suffering nosebleeds.
sentences.zh: 此后，亚伦开始流鼻血。

sentences.en: He continued to feel the cold intensely.
sentences.zh: 他继续感到强烈的寒冷。

sentences.en: Two days after his bad fall, Aaron said he could no longer carry his pack.
sentences.zh: 在那次严重摔倒的两天后，亚伦说他再也背不动背包了。

sentences.en: The weight was just too heavy and he wasn't strong enough to hike with it anymore.
sentences.zh: 重量实在太重了，他已经没有力气再背着它徒步了。

sentences.en: The counsellors refused to help, so Aaron had to abandon the backpack by the track with the intention of collecting it a couple of days later when they trekked back over the trail.
sentences.zh: 辅导员拒绝提供帮助，所以亚伦不得不把背包丢在小路上，打算几天后他们沿原路返回时再取回。

sentences.en: Because all students had to carry their own food,
sentences.zh: 因为所有学员都必须携带自己的食物，

sentences.en: Aaron wouldn't have access to his rations.
sentences.zh: 亚伦将无法获得他的口粮。

sentences.en: As punishment, the counsellors also confiscated his sleeping bag.
sentences.zh: 作为惩罚，辅导员还没收了他的睡袋。

sentences.en: Over the next couple of days,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，

sentences.en: Aaron tried to quell his hunger by eating things he and other students scavenged from the terrain, a raw lizard and a cooked scorpion.
sentences.zh: 亚伦试图通过吃他和同学从地形中搜寻到的东西来平息饥饿，比如生蜥蜴和煮熟的蝎子。

sentences.en: He hiked a little better without his pack, but still fell again, breaking a large water container he was carrying for the group.
sentences.zh: 丢掉背包后他走得稍微好了一点，但还是再次摔倒，打碎了他为小组携带的一个大水桶。

sentences.en: His situation started to improve later on Thursday March 17 when he got his pack back.
sentences.zh: 3月17日星期四晚些时候，当他拿回背包时，情况开始好转。

sentences.en: He was able to cook some rations and he got through that day's hike with no falls.
sentences.zh: 他能够烹饪一些口粮，并且顺利完成了当天的徒步，没有摔倒。

sentences.en: In his journal, he described it as my first good day here at North Star.
sentences.zh: 他在日志中将其描述为“我在北极星度过的第一个好日子”。

sentences.en: But the next day,
sentences.zh: 但第二天，

sentences.en: Aaron struggled to cross a chest-deep stream with the rest of the group.
sentences.zh: 亚伦在与小组其他人一起过一条齐胸深的溪流时遇到了困难。

sentences.en: He lacked the strength to lift his pack over his head to prevent it getting wet, so it and all of its contents were soaked.
sentences.zh: 他没有力气把背包举过头顶以防弄湿，所以背包和里面的所有东西都湿透了。

sentences.en: That night, he sat cold and shivering on the fringes of the group.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他冷得发抖，坐在小组的边缘。

sentences.en: He wasn't allowed near the fire for warmth and had to sleep in a wet sleeping bag.
sentences.zh: 他不被允许靠近火堆取暖，不得不睡在湿透的睡袋里。

sentences.en: Aaron wrote of how scared and sick he felt in his journal.
sentences.zh: 亚伦在日志中写下了他感到多么害怕和难受。

sentences.en: The pages were dotted with blood from his frequent nosebleeds and his handwriting was starting to become illegible.
sentences.zh: 书页上点缀着他频繁流鼻血留下的血迹，他的字迹也开始变得难以辨认。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, things worsened.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，情况恶化了。

sentences.en: Aaron had his sleeping bag confiscated again for lack of cooperation.
sentences.zh: 亚伦因为不配合，睡袋再次被没收。

sentences.en: He only had a wool blanket for warmth and was forced to sleep away from the rest of the group who huddled together near the fire and beneath a tarpaulin.
sentences.zh: 他只有一条羊毛毯子保暖，被迫睡在小组其他成员之外，其他人则挤在火堆旁和防水布下。

sentences.en: He was also barred from eating after failing to light a fire and went multiple days without food.
sentences.zh: 他还因为没能生起火而被禁止进食，连续几天没有食物。

sentences.en: Starving and still suffering intense stomach pain,
sentences.zh: 饥肠辘辘且胃痛难忍，

sentences.en: Aaron started to lose control of his bladder.
sentences.zh: 亚伦开始失去对膀胱的控制。

sentences.en: He began urinating himself during the night.
sentences.zh: 他开始在夜里尿床。

sentences.en: Then, as the group was setting out on the ninth day of the hike,
sentences.zh: 然后，当小组在徒步的第九天出发时，

sentences.en: Aaron accidentally defecated in his pants.
sentences.zh: 亚伦不小心拉在了裤子里。

sentences.en: He hadn't even felt the need to go to the toilet.
sentences.zh: 他甚至都没有感觉到想上厕所。

sentences.en: It had just happened without warning.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样毫无预兆地发生了。

sentences.en: When Aaron confided in 21-year-old Jeff Hohenstein, the most experienced of the three counsellors,
sentences.zh: 当亚伦向三名辅导员中最有经验的21岁的杰夫·霍恩斯坦吐露心声时，

sentences.en: Jeff yelled to another counsellor,
sentences.zh: 杰夫对另一名辅导员大喊：

sentences.en: Hey, he took a dump in his pants.
sentences.zh: “嘿，他拉裤子里了。”

sentences.en: The other counsellors and group members laughed.
sentences.zh: 其他辅导员和组员们都笑了。

sentences.en: Aaron told the counsellors,
sentences.zh: 亚伦告诉辅导员，

sentences.en: Aaron told Aaron that he was sick and needed medical attention, but they ignored his pleas and accused him of faking it.
sentences.zh: 亚伦告诉他们他病了，需要医疗救助，但他们无视了他的恳求，指责他在装病。

sentences.en: They told Aaron his incontinence was proof he had no self-respect.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉亚伦，他的失禁证明他没有自尊。

sentences.en: Aaron wrote in his journal,
sentences.zh: 亚伦在日志中写道，

sentences.en: I am in terrible condition here.
sentences.zh: “我在这里的情况糟透了。”

sentences.en: My hands are all chapped and my lips are cracking.
sentences.zh: “我的手都冻裂了，嘴唇也在开裂。”

sentences.en: I feel like I am losing control of my body.
sentences.zh: “我觉得我正在失去对自己身体的控制。”

sentences.en: The next morning, Aaron wasn't allowed breakfast and instead resorted to eating some prickly pear cactus.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，亚伦没能吃上早餐，只能靠吃一些仙人掌果实充饥。

sentences.en: That night, all of the students had dinner withheld
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，所有学员都被扣掉了晚餐，

sentences.en: Aaron was called as punishment for being late setting up camp.
sentences.zh: 亚伦因为扎营迟到而受到惩罚。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the counsellors had bacon and pork chops.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，辅导员们却在吃培根和猪排。

sentences.en: Aaron wrote in his journal,
sentences.zh: 亚伦在日志中写道，

sentences.en: All I can think about is cold and pain.
sentences.zh: “我满脑子想的都是寒冷和痛苦。”

sentences.en: I miss my family so much.
sentences.zh: “我太想念我的家人了。”

sentences.en: My hands, my lips and my face are dead.
sentences.zh: “我的手、嘴唇和脸都麻木了。”

sentences.en: It was his final entry.
sentences.zh: 这是他最后的一篇日记。

sentences.en: Aaron wasn't allowed to eat for the next three days as punishment for failing to keep his camp cup clean and deciding to again leave his pack behind.
sentences.zh: 亚伦因为没能保持营地杯清洁，并决定再次丢下背包，被惩罚在接下来的三天里不准进食。

sentences.en: Another student secretly gave him some powdered milk mixed with brown sugar and he consumed more cactus as well as a tea made from pine needles.
sentences.zh: 另一名学生偷偷给了他一些混合了红糖的奶粉，他还吃了更多的仙人掌以及用松针泡的茶。

sentences.en: Otherwise, he had nothing.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他什么都没有。

sentences.en: Members of the group could see how listless and flat Aaron had become.
sentences.zh: 小组成员都能看出亚伦变得多么无精打采、毫无生气。

sentences.en: He was pale, his cheeks looked hollow and he had grown even thinner than he already was.
sentences.zh: 他脸色苍白，脸颊凹陷，比以前更瘦了。

sentences.en: Aaron continued to complain about his stomach ache and the cold but the counsellors refused his requests to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 亚伦继续抱怨胃痛和寒冷，但辅导员拒绝了他看医生的请求。

sentences.en: They gave him nothing at night to stay warm despite Aaron having no sleeping bag or blanket due to leaving his pack behind.
sentences.zh: 尽管亚伦因为丢下背包而没有睡袋或毯子，但他们晚上什么保暖的东西都没给他。

sentences.en: On the evening of the hike's 14th day,
sentences.zh: 在徒步旅行的第14天晚上，

sentences.en: Lance Jagger and his business partner, Bill Henry, paid a visit to the group.
sentences.zh: 兰斯·贾格尔和他的商业伙伴比尔·亨利探访了该小组。

sentences.en: They gave Aaron a blanket to sleep with but refused to let him join the other group members under the shelter.
sentences.zh: 他们给了亚伦一条毯子睡觉，但拒绝让他加入其他组员在遮蔽处休息。

sentences.en: The next morning, Lance and Bill demanded the teenagers perform a series of exercises including 100 jumping jacks and 100 sit-ups.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，兰斯和比尔要求青少年们进行一系列锻炼，包括100个开合跳和100个仰卧起坐。

sentences.en: Aaron could only manage 10 sit-ups by himself.
sentences.zh: 亚伦自己只能做10个仰卧起坐。

sentences.en: The counsellors helped him do another 25.
sentences.zh: 辅导员帮他做了另外25个。

sentences.en: By this stage, Aaron was unable to walk much and only managed to hike a total of 2 miles.
sentences.zh: 到了这个阶段，亚伦已经无法走太多路，总共只走了2英里。

sentences.en: He could hardly move unless someone else helped him stand up.
sentences.zh: 除非有人帮他站起来，否则他几乎无法移动。

sentences.en: The counsellors began to let him eat again, giving him some rice and lentils but he later threw them up.
sentences.zh: 辅导员开始让他重新进食，给他一些米饭和扁豆，但他后来都吐了出来。

sentences.en: When Aaron yet again complained about stomach pain on Monday March 28, the counsellors repeatedly accused him of malingering.
sentences.zh: 3月28日星期一，当亚伦再次抱怨胃痛时，辅导员反复指责他在装病。

sentences.en: Aaron explained that it hurt him to eat and asked to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 亚伦解释说他吃东西时很痛，并要求看医生。

sentences.en: They told him they were a long way away from any doctors.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他，离任何医生都很远。

sentences.en: The following day, the group had to perform a full-body hygiene task which involved stripping down, hand-washing their clothes and bathing.
sentences.zh: 第二天，小组必须进行一项全身卫生任务，包括脱掉衣服、手洗衣服和洗澡。

sentences.en: The other teenagers noticed how scrawny Aaron had become, later describing him as looking like a victim from a Nazi concentration camp.
sentences.zh: 其他青少年注意到亚伦变得多么瘦弱，后来形容他看起来就像纳粹集中营的受害者。

sentences.en: Aaron struggled to walk without falling down.
sentences.zh: 亚伦走路都很吃力，随时会摔倒。

sentences.en: Even lifting firewood was too difficult for him.
sentences.zh: 即使是搬运柴火对他来说也太困难了。

sentences.en: He was able to eat small amounts of food but he kept moaning and saying he was dizzy.
sentences.zh: 他能吃少量的食物，但一直呻吟着说自己头晕。

sentences.en: When he looked at the sky, he hallucinated streaks of purple and flashing lights.
sentences.zh: 当他看向天空时，他产生了幻觉，看到了紫色的条纹和闪烁的光芒。

sentences.en: He also told the others he was seeing spots.
sentences.zh: 他还告诉其他人他看到了光斑。

sentences.en: On Wednesday March 30, the counsellors finally requested help, radioing North Star's emergency medical technician,
sentences.zh: 3月30日星期三，辅导员终于请求帮助，用无线电联系了北极星营地的紧急医疗技术员，

sentences.en: Georgette Costigan.
sentences.zh: 乔吉特·科斯蒂根。

sentences.en: She came to the camp to check on Aaron.
sentences.zh: 她来到营地查看亚伦的情况。

sentences.en: However, the counsellors didn't tell her of his extensive complaints or that he'd barely eaten anything or slept in a sleeping bag for days.
sentences.zh: 然而，辅导员并没有告诉她亚伦的严重抱怨，也没有说他已经好几天几乎没吃东西或睡在睡袋里了。

sentences.en: Georgette noticed Aaron's skin was dry and flushed but didn't perform a medical exam.
sentences.zh: 乔吉特注意到亚伦的皮肤干燥且潮红，但并没有进行医学检查。

sentences.en: Figuring it was nothing serious, she refused the counsellor's request that she take Aaron back with her, instead saying she'd check on him again the next day.
sentences.zh: 她认为没什么大碍，拒绝了辅导员让她带亚伦回去的请求，反而说她第二天会再来看看他。

sentences.en: She gave Aaron a slice of cheese and made him promise to keep hiking.
sentences.zh: 她给了亚伦一片奶酪，并让他保证继续徒步。

sentences.en: Later that evening,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上晚些时候，

sentences.en: Aaron vomited and moaned repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 亚伦呕吐并反复呻吟。

sentences.en: While the other teens sat around the fire writing in their journals, he sat alone with his head tilted to one side, his mouth open and drooling.
sentences.zh: 当其他青少年坐在火堆旁写日记时，他独自坐着，头歪向一边，嘴巴张开，流着口水。

sentences.en: Counsellor Craig Fisher told him to stop it and mimicked him.
sentences.zh: 辅导员克雷格·费舍尔让他停下来，并模仿他的样子。

sentences.en: That night,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，

sentences.en: Aaron was allowed to sleep in a sleeping bag for the first time in eight nights.
sentences.zh: 亚伦八天来第一次被允许睡在睡袋里。

sentences.en: Before going to bed, he told Craig Fisher that he didn't want to die.
sentences.zh: 睡觉前，他告诉克雷格·费舍尔，他不想死。

sentences.en: Craig assured him that he wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 克雷格向他保证他不会死。

sentences.en: The next morning, it took Aaron an hour to crawl the 20 feet from his sleeping bag to the campfire.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，亚伦花了一个小时才从睡袋爬到营火旁，全程只有20英尺。

sentences.en: He repeatedly fell asleep during this attempt to reach the group.
sentences.zh: 在试图靠近小组的过程中，他反复睡着。

sentences.en: The counsellors had to pick him up off the ground as he was unable to stand on his own.
sentences.zh: 辅导员不得不把他从地上扶起来，因为他无法独自站立。

sentences.en: Aaron said that he needed to use the bathroom and was unable to make it to the latrine that the group used by himself.
sentences.zh: 亚伦说他需要上厕所，但无法独自走到小组使用的那个简易厕所。

sentences.en: The counsellors carried him there, then left Aaron alone.
sentences.zh: 辅导员把他抬到那里，然后把亚伦独自留在了那里。

sentences.en: One of the staff members radioed Mike Hill, a counsellor with another group, to ask if Aaron could be left with them as he was unable to walk and the emergency medical technician
sentences.zh: 其中一名工作人员用无线电联系了迈克·希尔，他是另一个小组的辅导员，询问亚伦是否可以留在他们那里，因为他无法行走，而紧急医疗技术员

sentences.en: would be visiting Mike's group that day.
sentences.zh: 当天会去探访迈克的小组。

sentences.en: Mike agreed and offered to collect Aaron with some of his campers.
sentences.zh: 迈克同意了，并提出带一些营员去接亚伦。

sentences.en: When he arrived at the primitive camp, he was shocked to discover Aaron sitting inside the latrine covered with excrement.
sentences.zh: 当他到达那个原始营地时，他震惊地发现亚伦坐在厕所里，身上沾满了排泄物。

sentences.en: He had fallen in and was unable to get up.
sentences.zh: 他掉进去了，却无法站起来。

sentences.en: One of Aaron's counsellors mocked him by imitating the way he had collapsed and told Mike that Aaron was deliberately starving himself because he wanted to die.
sentences.zh: 亚伦的一名辅导员嘲笑他，模仿他倒下的样子，并告诉迈克，亚伦是因为想死而故意绝食。

sentences.en: Horrified,
sentences.zh: 感到震惊，

sentences.en: Mike and several of his campers lifted Aaron out of the latrine and carried him to a shady spot.
sentences.zh: 迈克和他的几名营员把亚伦从厕所里抬出来，带到了一个阴凉处。

sentences.en: Are you doing this because you want to die?
sentences.zh: 你这样做是因为你想死吗？

sentences.en: Mike asked Aaron.
sentences.zh: 迈克问亚伦。

sentences.en: No, sir, Aaron replied.
sentences.zh: 不，先生，亚伦回答道。

sentences.en: I don't want to die, sir.
sentences.zh: 我不想死，先生。

sentences.en: Mike made Aaron some oatmeal but he only managed to eat a few spoonfuls.
sentences.zh: 迈克给亚伦做了一些燕麦粥，但他只勉强吃了两三勺。

sentences.en: In a hoarse voice, he told Mike that all he could see was a white glare.
sentences.zh: 他用嘶哑的声音告诉迈克，他眼前只能看到一片白光。

sentences.en: A Native American man from the Apache tribe,
sentences.zh: 作为一名来自阿帕奇部落的美国原住民，

sentences.en: Mike later said he knew then that Aaron was dying.
sentences.zh: 迈克后来表示，他当时就知道亚伦快不行了。

sentences.en: He took out some Apache healing powder he kept in his pocket and sprinkled it around Aaron.
sentences.zh: 他拿出放在口袋里的一些阿帕奇疗愈粉，撒在亚伦周围。

sentences.en: Then he knelt and prayed.
sentences.zh: 然后他跪下来祈祷。

sentences.en: One of the boys camping with Mike's group began to cry.
sentences.zh: 迈克小组里的一名男孩开始哭泣。

sentences.en: Some time later,
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，

sentences.en: Mike received a message from Eric Henry, the son of North Star co-owner Bill Henry, that he was headed their way with a truck to collect Aaron.
sentences.zh: 迈克收到了埃里克·亨利的消息，他是北极星共同所有人比尔·亨利的儿子，说他正带着一辆卡车赶来接亚伦。

sentences.en: Get the faker ready,
sentences.zh: 把那个装病的人准备好，

sentences.en: Eric said.
sentences.zh: 埃里克说。

sentences.en: When he arrived,
sentences.zh: 当他到达时，

sentences.en: Eric lifted Aaron into the back seat as he was unable to get up by himself, then spent about 15 minutes chatting with other staff members.
sentences.zh: 埃里克把亚伦抬进后座，因为他无法独自起身，然后花了大约15分钟与其他工作人员聊天。

sentences.en: Just before 3pm, they heard a banging sound coming from the truck.
sentences.zh: 下午3点前不久，他们听到卡车里传来砰砰的声音。

sentences.en: Aaron was slumped, unconscious, his head knocked against the back window.
sentences.zh: 亚伦瘫倒在地，失去知觉，头撞在后窗上。

sentences.en: He had no pulse and his heart had stopped.
sentences.zh: 他没有脉搏，心脏已经停止跳动。

sentences.en: Eric Henry and Mike Hill pulled Aaron from the car and Eric radioed base camp while Mike tried to administer CPR.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·亨利和迈克·希尔把亚伦从车里拉出来，埃里克用无线电呼叫基地营地，而迈克试图进行心肺复苏。

sentences.en: Georgette Costigan, the emergency medical technician, soon arrived at the scene and attempted to revive Aaron.
sentences.zh: 紧急医疗技术员乔吉特·科斯蒂根很快赶到现场，试图抢救亚伦。

sentences.en: She was joined by the physician's assistant who'd examined Aaron when he was first admitted to the program, but didn't recognise the frail and gaunt boy in front of him.
sentences.zh: 助理医师也加入了抢救，他曾在亚伦刚被录取时检查过他，但没认出眼前这个虚弱消瘦的男孩。

sentences.en: Advanced life support procedures were performed on Aaron without success.
sentences.zh: 对亚伦进行了高级生命支持程序，但没有成功。

sentences.en: Georgette repeatedly cried out,
sentences.zh: 乔吉特反复喊道，

sentences.en: Oh shit!
sentences.zh: 该死！

sentences.en: Oh shit!
sentences.zh: 该死！

sentences.en: A helicopter was sent for and Aaron was flown to a hospital in Page, Arizona where he was pronounced dead.
sentences.zh: 一架直升机被派来，亚伦被送往亚利桑那州佩奇市的一家医院，在那里被宣布死亡。

sentences.en: When North Star Expeditions called the Bacon family to inform them of Aaron's passing, they used vague language and implied there had been some sort of tragic accident.
sentences.zh: 当北极星探险公司打电话给培根一家告知亚伦去世的消息时，他们使用了含糊的语言，暗示发生了一场悲剧性的意外。

sentences.en: Bob Bacon was left with the impression that Aaron had suddenly collapsed out of the blue, perhaps after accidentally eating some kind of poisonous vegetation.

sentences.zh: 在亚伦死后的几周内，营地接受了检查，被发现完全符合

sentences.en: Utah's regulations, but the police still had their doubts.
sentences.zh: 犹他州的法规，但警方仍存有疑虑。

sentences.en: In early September, they conducted a surprise inspection of North Star's headquarters with two doctors, a psychologist and a nurse examining the 21 adolescents who were in
sentences.zh: 9月初，他们对“北极星”总部进行了突击检查，两名医生、一名心理学家和一名护士检查了当时在他们照看下的21名青少年。

sentences.en: their care.
sentences.zh: （接上文）

sentences.en: They determined that three girls staying with North Star weren't well enough to continue with the program.
sentences.zh: 他们认定，留在“北极星”的三名女孩身体状况已不足以继续参加该项目。

sentences.en: They were removed and had to stay with foster families until their guardians could take them home.
sentences.zh: 她们被带走，并必须寄宿在寄养家庭，直到监护人能接她们回家。

sentences.en: North Star continued to operate for its other campers.
sentences.zh: “北极星”继续为其其他营员运营。

sentences.en: When LA Times journalist Joe
sentences.zh: 当《洛杉矶时报》记者乔·摩根斯坦在事态发展后联系“北极星”联合创始人兰斯·贾格尔时，

sentences.en: Morgenstein contacted North Star co-founder Lance Jagger following this development, he described the inspection as a witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 他将这次检查描述为一场“猎巫行动”。

sentences.en: He thought it was ridiculous that investigators were listening to, quote, solely the words of the kids.
sentences.zh: 他认为调查人员只听取“孩子们的片面之词”是荒谬的。

sentences.en: North Star representatives were adamant that there was no way they could have known about Aaron's condition.
sentences.zh: “北极星”的代表坚称，他们绝不可能知道亚伦的病情。

sentences.en: One spokesperson even claimed he hadn't been deprived of food, but instead rejected the food offered to him.
sentences.zh: 一位发言人甚至声称他并没有被剥夺食物，而是他自己拒绝了提供的食物。

sentences.en: Co-owner Bill Henry blamed Aaron Bacon's cannabis usage for his death, insisting he must have had his ulcer for a long time, but his history of smoking pot must
sentences.zh: 共同所有者比尔·亨利将亚伦·培根的死归咎于他使用大麻，坚称他的溃疡一定存在很久了，但吸食大麻的习惯一定

sentences.en: have masked the pain.
sentences.zh: 掩盖了疼痛。

sentences.en: Joe Morgenstein fact-checked this claim with doctors, who said that nothing could have covered the pain of a perforated ulcer.
sentences.zh: 乔·摩根斯坦向医生核实了这一说法，医生表示，没有任何东西能掩盖溃疡穿孔带来的剧痛。

sentences.en: Just over a month after the surprise inspection of North Star, prosecutors charged Lance Jagger, Bill Henry, and six of their employees with felony child abuse charges.
sentences.zh: 在对“北极星”进行突击检查一个多月后，检察官以重罪虐待儿童罪起诉了兰斯·贾格尔、比尔·亨利及其六名员工。

sentences.en: Georgette Costigan, the camp's emergency medical technician, was also charged with witness tampering.
sentences.zh: 营地的急救医疗技术员乔吉特·科斯蒂根也被控妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: According to Mike Hill, the counsellor for another group who had tried to help Aaron in his final moments, she had tried to convince some of the students to revise their
sentences.zh: 据另一组试图在亚伦生命最后时刻帮助他的辅导员迈克·希尔称，她曾试图说服一些学生修改他们

sentences.en: written statements for the sheriff's office to make them look less incriminating.
sentences.zh: 给警长办公室的书面陈述，以使他们看起来不那么有罪。

sentences.en: These charges against Georgette Costigan were later dropped due to a lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 由于证据不足，针对乔吉特·科斯蒂根的这些指控后来被撤销了。

sentences.en: The prosecutors had other problems that would make pursuing the case difficult.
sentences.zh: 检察官还面临其他使案件起诉变得困难的问题。

sentences.en: Although 22-year-old North Star employee Mike
sentences.zh: 尽管22岁的“北极星”员工迈克·希尔曾试图帮助亚伦，但他很快承认自己曾对另一名营员犯罪。

sentences.en: Hill had tried to help Aaron, he soon confessed that he'd committed a crime against another camper.
sentences.zh: （接上文）

sentences.en: In December 1993, he had sexually abused a
sentences.zh: 1993年12月，他曾在之前的项目中性虐待了一名17岁的男孩，

sentences.en: 17-year-old boy in a previous program and made him perform sex acts in exchange for food.
sentences.zh: 并强迫他以性行为换取食物。

sentences.en: This crime completely undermined Hill's credibility as a witness.
sentences.zh: 这一罪行彻底削弱了希尔作为证人的可信度。

sentences.en: Hill subsequently pleaded guilty to one count of forcible sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 希尔随后对一项强迫性虐待罪名表示认罪。

sentences.en: He had been the only North Star staff member willing to testify against the company, but the prosecutors knew they could no longer use him.
sentences.zh: 他曾是唯一愿意出庭指证该公司的“北极星”员工，但检察官知道他们不能再使用他了。

sentences.en: However, two of Aaron's fellow campers were willing to testify and did so at a preliminary hearing.
sentences.zh: 然而，亚伦的两名营友愿意作证，并在预审听证会上这样做了。

sentences.en: In closing arguments, a lawyer for the prosecution stated,
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，检方律师陈述道：

sentences.en: Once it was decided that Aaron was a faker, a manipulator, that was the party line at North Star.
sentences.zh: 一旦认定亚伦是个骗子、操纵者，这就是“北极星”的统一口径。

sentences.en: They said, we ignore Aaron because he's faking.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们无视亚伦，因为他在装病。

sentences.en: I don't know how you fake a 23-pound weight loss in 24 days.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你怎么能装出24天内体重减轻23磅的效果。

sentences.en: Following the hearing, all of the defendants were ordered to stand trial.
sentences.zh: 听证会后，所有被告都被勒令接受审判。

sentences.en: Eventually, most of the defendants struck plea deals that saw their felony charges reduced.
sentences.zh: 最终，大多数被告达成了认罪协议，使他们的重罪指控得以减轻。

sentences.en: Five of them pleaded guilty to negligent homicide, which is a Class A misdemeanor in Utah.
sentences.zh: 其中五人承认了过失杀人罪，这在犹他州属于A级轻罪。

sentences.en: Those who accepted this plea included two of Aaron's counsellors, Sonny Duncan and Jeff Hohenstein, emergency medical technician Georgette Costigan,
sentences.zh: 接受此认罪协议的人包括亚伦的两名辅导员桑尼·邓肯和杰夫·霍恩斯坦，急救医疗技术员乔吉特·科斯蒂根，

sentences.en: and North Star co-owners Lance Jagger and Bill Henry.
sentences.zh: 以及“北极星”共同所有者兰斯·贾格尔和比尔·亨利。

sentences.en: Jagger and Henry also pleaded guilty to operating a program that violated licensing regulations.
sentences.zh: 贾格尔和亨利还承认了经营违反许可规定的项目。

sentences.en: These defendants were given a one-year suspended sentence, three years probation, and ordered to each pay a $2,500 fine.
sentences.zh: 这些被告被判处一年缓刑，三年察看期，并被勒令每人支付2500美元罚款。

sentences.en: They were also ordered to perform community service.
sentences.zh: 他们还被勒令进行社区服务。

sentences.en: The sixth defendant pleaded guilty to a lesser charge of attempting to abuse a disabled child.
sentences.zh: 第六名被告承认了较轻的试图虐待残疾儿童的罪名。

sentences.en: Aaron Bacon fit the legal definition of being a disabled child as his physical illness that began shortly after he arrived at North Star left him unable to care for himself.
sentences.zh: 亚伦·培根符合法律对残疾儿童的定义，因为他在到达“北极星”后不久开始的身体疾病使他无法照顾自己。

sentences.en: This defendant received probation and community service.
sentences.zh: 该被告被判处察看期和社区服务。

sentences.en: And the seventh defendant was permitted to sign a diversion program agreement in exchange for nine months of good behaviour.
sentences.zh: 第七名被告被允许签署一项分流项目协议，以换取九个月的良好表现。

sentences.en: Craig Fisher had been just 19 when he'd had to care for Aaron as one of his three rotating camp counsellors.
sentences.zh: 克雷格·费舍尔在担任亚伦的三名轮换营地辅导员之一时年仅19岁。

sentences.en: He had demonstrated a rather belligerent attitude during the preliminary hearing, with Sally Bacon reporting that when the judge wasn't looking,
sentences.zh: 他在预审听证会上表现出相当好斗的态度，萨莉·培根报告说，当法官没注意时，

sentences.en: Fisher had looked at her, sneered, and given her the finger.
sentences.zh: 费舍尔盯着她，冷笑，并向她竖起了中指。

sentences.en: While his co-defendants had been convinced to accept plea agreements to avoid a long trial and harsher charges,
sentences.zh: 虽然他的共同被告被说服接受认罪协议以避免漫长的审判和更严厉的指控，

sentences.en: Fisher rejected the idea outright.
sentences.zh: 但费舍尔断然拒绝了这个想法。

sentences.en: He went to trial facing the third-degree felony charge of abuse or neglect of a disabled child.
sentences.zh: 他因面临虐待或忽视残疾儿童的三级重罪指控而接受审判。

sentences.en: Some of Aaron's fellow campers were called as witnesses, as were the other North Star employees who'd pleaded out.
sentences.zh: 亚伦的一些营友被传唤作证，其他已认罪的“北极星”员工也被传唤。

sentences.en: Aaron Bacon's parents also testified.
sentences.zh: 亚伦·培根的父母也出庭作证。

sentences.en: Craig Fisher's attorney argued that his client had merely been following the orders of his superiors and had no real say in how Aaron Bacon was to be treated.
sentences.zh: 克雷格·费舍尔的律师辩称，他的当事人只是在执行上级的命令，对亚伦·培根如何被对待没有真正的发言权。

sentences.en: When his client had responded to Aaron's complaints by yelling at him, he'd just been trying to help him.
sentences.zh: 当他的当事人通过对他大喊大叫来回应亚伦的抱怨时，他只是想帮助他。

sentences.en: It didn't take the jury long to find Craig Fisher guilty.
sentences.zh: 陪审团没花多久就裁定克雷格·费舍尔有罪。

sentences.en: After his conviction,
sentences.zh: 定罪后，

sentences.en: Fisher went to hug Sally Bacon, telling her he'd had no idea how sick Aaron had really been.
sentences.zh: 费舍尔去拥抱萨莉·培根，告诉她他根本不知道亚伦病得有多重。

sentences.en: Sally replied that even if he hadn't known how unwell Aaron was, he hadn't done anything to help him.
sentences.zh: 萨莉回答说，即使他不知道亚伦病得有多重，他也什么都没做来帮助他。

sentences.en: She told Fisher that she hoped he would learn from the tragedy and would never again treat another human that badly.
sentences.zh: 她告诉费舍尔，她希望他能从这场悲剧中吸取教训，永远不要再那样对待另一个人。

sentences.en: Then she hugged him back in a display of forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 然后她回抱了他，展现出宽恕。

sentences.en: When it came time for Craig Fisher to be sentenced, his attorney pointed to this hug as a sign of his client's remorse.
sentences.zh: 当克雷格·费舍尔被判刑时，他的律师指出这个拥抱是他当事人悔改的标志。

sentences.en: This left Sally feeling used, and when she stood to read her victim impact statement, she made sure to mention how Fisher had previously glared at her and given the finger.
sentences.zh: 这让萨莉感到被利用了，当她站起来宣读受害者影响陈述时，她特意提到了费舍尔之前是如何怒视她并竖中指的。

sentences.en: Fisher was ultimately sentenced to one year in a county jail.
sentences.zh: 费舍尔最终被判处一年县监狱监禁。

sentences.en: He appealed his conviction and loSt.
sentences.zh: 他上诉了定罪，但败诉了。

sentences.en: Fisher was later released after serving only a few months of his sentence.
sentences.zh: 费舍尔后来在服刑仅几个月后就被释放了。

sentences.en: Sally and Bob Bacon filed a civil suit against North Star, which was settled out of court and paid by the defendant's insurance companies.
sentences.zh: 萨莉和鲍勃·培根对“北极星”提起了民事诉讼，该案在庭外和解，并由被告的保险公司支付赔偿。

sentences.en: The couple also became crusaders against the wilderness therapy industry, speaking out in the news and on television programs about how they were misled
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇还成为了反对野外治疗行业的斗士，在新闻和电视节目中公开讲述他们是如何被误导的，

sentences.en: and what their son's experience had been.
sentences.zh: 以及他们儿子的经历。

sentences.en: They also demanded stronger legislation and industry oversight.
sentences.zh: 他们还要求加强立法和行业监管。

sentences.en: In an interview with the Salt Lake Tribune,
sentences.zh: 在接受《盐湖城论坛报》采访时，

sentences.en: Bob Bacon stated,
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·培根表示：

sentences.en: The ignorance, arrogance, incompetence, callousness, and greed of the people running these programs is proving repeatedly to be dangerous, abusive, and even fatal.
sentences.zh: 经营这些项目的人的无知、傲慢、无能、冷酷和贪婪，一再被证明是危险、虐待甚至致命的。

sentences.en: The lessons are not being learned.
sentences.zh: 教训并没有被吸取。

sentences.en: The Bacons faced harsh pushback from wilderness therapy advocates who victim-blamed and smeared their family's name by claiming Aaron, Sally, and Bob were all drug addicts.
sentences.zh: 培根夫妇遭到了野外治疗倡导者的强烈抵制，他们通过声称亚伦、萨莉和鲍勃都是瘾君子来指责受害者并抹黑他们的家庭名声。

sentences.en: Parents of other children who'd been enrolled at wilderness therapy camps were among those critiquing the couple.
sentences.zh: 其他曾参加野外治疗营的孩子们的家长也在批评这对夫妇的人之列。

sentences.en: Six months after Aaron's death, the state of Utah revoked North Star's license and the camp was permanently shut down.
sentences.zh: 在亚伦死后六个月，犹他州吊销了“北极星”的执照，营地被永久关闭。

sentences.en: Some parents were furious about this, with one mother asking Sally,
sentences.zh: 一些家长对此感到愤怒，一位母亲问萨莉：

sentences.en: Where did you think you were sending him?
sentences.zh: 你以为你把他送到哪儿去了？

sentences.en: At daycare?
sentences.zh: 托儿所吗？

sentences.en: Sally later told author Maya Solovitz about this interaction and added,
sentences.zh: 萨莉后来告诉作家玛雅·索洛维茨关于这次互动的情况，并补充道：

sentences.en: They wanted a boot camp, and that's what they were sold.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一个新兵训练营，这就是卖给他们的东西。

sentences.en: I didn't want a boot camp, so that's what I was sold.
sentences.zh: 我不想要新兵训练营，所以这就是卖给我的东西。

sentences.en: And see, that's what they didn't understand.
sentences.zh: 你看，这就是他们不明白的地方。

sentences.en: These people sell you whatever you're looking for.
sentences.zh: 这些人会卖给你任何你想要的东西。

sentences.en: In her 2006 book,
sentences.zh: 在她的2006年著作

sentences.en: Help at Any Cost,
sentences.zh: 《不惜一切代价的帮助：

sentences.en: How the Troubled Teen Industry Cons Parents
sentences.zh: 问题青少年行业如何欺骗家长》中，

sentences.en: Mayer Solovitz noted that at least nine other children had died in wilderness therapy programs in the years following Aaron's death.
sentences.zh: 玛雅·索洛维茨指出，在亚伦死后的几年里，至少还有九名儿童在野外治疗项目中死亡。

sentences.en: Most of these deaths occurred when teenagers were denied requests for water, food, or medical attention.
sentences.zh: 这些死亡大多发生在青少年请求水、食物或医疗救助被拒绝时。

sentences.en: That number has increased in the years since Solovitz's book was published, with non-profit organization Breaking Code Silence counting more than 30 wilderness therapy deaths
sentences.zh: 自索洛维茨的书出版以来，这个数字有所增加，非营利组织“打破沉默准则”统计，自1990年以来，野外治疗项目中有超过30人死亡，

sentences.en: since 1990 and 175 in the troubled teen industry overall.
sentences.zh: 整个问题青少年行业总共有175人死亡。

sentences.en: One occurred as recently as February 2024 when a 12-year-old boy was found dead at a camp in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 最近的一次发生在2024年2月，一名12岁男孩被发现死在北卡罗来纳州的一个营地里。

sentences.en: Other abuses aren't fatal, but have still resulted in trauma.
sentences.zh: 其他的虐待行为虽然不致命，但仍然造成了创伤。

sentences.en: Children have been forced to perform manual labor, ordered to attack one another verbally in order to gain privileges, and sexually assaulted.
sentences.zh: 孩子们被迫从事体力劳动，被命令互相言语攻击以换取特权，并遭到性侵犯。

sentences.en: Other abuses have included the denial of basic hygiene and sanitary items, and forcing teens to march with their ankles tired until their feet bled.
sentences.zh: 其他虐待行为包括拒绝提供基本的卫生和清洁用品，并强迫青少年戴着脚镣行军，直到双脚流血。

sentences.en: In one instance, a girl was made to dress as a sex worker and given a name tag that read shameful slut.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一个女孩被迫打扮成性工作者，并被贴上写着“可耻的荡妇”的名牌。

sentences.en: The boys in her group were told to call her slut, hoe, and bitch.
sentences.zh: 她小组里的男孩被告知要叫她“荡妇”、“妓女”和“婊子”。

sentences.en: Some teenagers were forced to wear diapers, gagged with sanitary products, and ordered to clean toilets with their bare hands.
sentences.zh: 一些青少年被迫穿尿布，用卫生用品堵住嘴，并被命令用赤手清洁厕所。

sentences.en: There have been numerous cases of teenagers suiciding while in treatment prograMs.
sentences.zh: 在治疗项目中，青少年自杀的案例不胜枚举。

sentences.en: Or coming to harm after trying to run away from one.
sentences.zh: 或者在试图逃跑后受到伤害。

sentences.en: Although different states have passed laws relating to the troubled teen industry over the years, a lack of regulation and oversight
sentences.zh: 尽管多年来各州通过了与问题青少年行业相关的法律，但缺乏监管和监督

sentences.en: has meant that teenagers have continued to suffer at the hands of unqualified and abusive individuals.
sentences.zh: 意味着青少年继续在不合格和虐待成性的人手中受苦。

sentences.en: In 2020, the industry was in the national spotlight again when media personality Paris Hilton spoke out publicly about her experience at Provo Canyon School,
sentences.zh: 2020年，当媒体名人帕里斯·希尔顿公开谈论她在普罗沃峡谷学校的经历时，该行业再次成为全国关注的焦点。

sentences.en: an involuntary residential treatment centre for teens in Provo, Utah.
sentences.zh: 位于犹他州普罗沃的一家青少年非自愿寄宿治疗中心。

sentences.en: In the late 1990s, when Hilton was 16, she had gone through a rebellious phase.
sentences.zh: 20世纪90年代末，16岁的希尔顿正处于叛逆期。

sentences.en: Her parents eventually sent her to a wilderness therapy camp and later Provo Canyon School in the hopes it would correct her behaviour.
sentences.zh: 她的父母最终将她送往一家荒野治疗营，后来又送到了普罗沃峡谷学校，希望能以此纠正她的行为。

sentences.en: Hilton stayed at Provo Canyon School for 11 months and was released around the time she turned 18.
sentences.zh: 希尔顿在普罗沃峡谷学校待了11个月，在快满18岁时获释。

sentences.en: She has testified before Congress about her experiences in these troubled teen programs, stating,
sentences.zh: 她曾在国会作证，讲述了自己在这些问题青少年项目中的经历，并表示：

sentences.en: These programs promised healing, growth and support, but instead did not allow me to speak, move freely or even look out a window for two years.
sentences.zh: 这些项目承诺提供治愈、成长和支持，但实际上，在两年的时间里，他们不让我说话、不让我自由活动，甚至不让我看向窗外。

sentences.en: I was force-fed medications and sexually abused by the staff.
sentences.zh: 我被强行喂食药物，并遭到工作人员的性虐待。

sentences.en: I was violently restrained and dragged down hallways, stripped naked and thrown into solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 我遭到暴力束缚，被拖过走廊，被剥光衣服，并被关进禁闭室。

sentences.en: My parents were completely deceived, lied to and manipulated by this for-profit industry about the inhumane treatment I was experiencing.
sentences.zh: 我的父母完全被这个营利性行业欺骗、蒙蔽和操纵了，他们根本不知道我正在遭受非人的待遇。

sentences.en: Paris Hilton's revelations led to others coming forward to share their stories on social media, as well as increased attention from journalists and the public.
sentences.zh: 帕里斯·希尔顿的揭露促使其他人站出来在社交媒体上分享自己的故事，也引起了记者和公众的更多关注。

sentences.en: Hilton subsequently worked with Utah lawmakers on a new law aimed at improving industry regulation.
sentences.zh: 随后，希尔顿与犹他州立法者合作，制定了一项旨在改善行业监管的新法律。

sentences.en: It came into effect in March 2021.
sentences.zh: 该法律于2021年3月生效。

sentences.en: Under this law, troubled teen programs have to submit to more annual inspections and report use of physical restraints to the Utah Office of Licensing.
sentences.zh: 根据这项法律，问题青少年项目必须接受更多的年度检查，并向犹他州许可办公室报告身体约束的使用情况。

sentences.en: As of 2024, there is still no federal oversight of the troubled teen industry and there are more than 10,000 such programs operating in the United States.
sentences.zh: 截至2024年，美国的问题青少年行业仍无联邦监管，且有超过10000个此类项目在运营。

sentences.en: Utah has more of these facilities than anywhere else in the world.
sentences.zh: 犹他州拥有的此类设施比世界上任何其他地方都多。

sentences.en: This is due in part to the state's strict parental laws, which supports parents making decisions for their children over a minor's personal wishes.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上归因于该州严格的父母权利法，该法支持父母为孩子做决定，而非尊重未成年人的个人意愿。

sentences.en: While many states have now made it illegal to hold teenagers in such programs against their will, this is not the case in Utah.
sentences.zh: 虽然许多州现在已立法禁止违背青少年意愿将其关在这些项目中，但犹他州并非如此。

sentences.en: It's estimated that the industry still brings the state almost half a billion dollars in revenue each year.
sentences.zh: 据估计，该行业每年仍为该州带来近五亿美元的收入。

sentences.en: The individuals who were charged for the death of Aaron Bacon moved on with their lives.
sentences.zh: 那些因亚伦·培根之死而被起诉的人，生活并没有受到太大影响。

sentences.en: North Star co-owner Bill Henry violated the terms of his probation by only completing 86 hours of community service instead of the court-ordered 1,440 hours.
sentences.zh: “北极星”联合创始人比尔·亨利违反了缓刑条款，他只完成了86小时的社区服务，而法院判决的是1440小时。

sentences.en: He then violated it again by moving interstate to Oregon, where his wife had been hired by another wilderness therapy program.
sentences.zh: 随后，他又因跨州搬迁到俄勒冈州再次违反缓刑规定，他的妻子在那里被另一家荒野治疗项目聘用。

sentences.en: The couple's son, Eric Henry, was later hired by the same company whilst still on probation for his role in Aaron Bacon's death.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的儿子埃里克·亨利后来也被同一家公司聘用，当时他仍因在亚伦·培根死亡案中的角色而处于缓刑期。

sentences.en: In 2023, streaming platform Netflix released a documentary about wilderness therapy titled Hell Camp, which focused primarily on the programs led by Steve Cardizano.
sentences.zh: 2023年，流媒体平台Netflix发布了一部关于荒野治疗的纪录片《地狱营》，主要聚焦于史蒂夫·卡迪扎诺领导的项目。

sentences.en: Lance Jagger appeared in the documentary to talk about his time as an employee at Cardizano's program Challenger.
sentences.zh: 兰斯·贾格尔在纪录片中露面，谈论了他作为卡迪扎诺旗下“挑战者”项目员工的那段时光。

sentences.en: Now well into his middle age and wearing a breathing tube,
sentences.zh: 如今他已步入中年，戴着呼吸管，

sentences.en: Jagger stated,
sentences.zh: 贾格尔声称：

sentences.en: We didn't break them down to punish them.
sentences.zh: 我们摧毁他们并不是为了惩罚他们。

sentences.en: We broke them down to get rid of the old crap and helped them be a better and more positive person.
sentences.zh: 我们摧毁他们是为了清除那些旧的糟粕，帮助他们成为更好、更积极的人。

sentences.en: Some of the kids were so scared they'd almost pass out.
sentences.zh: 有些孩子害怕得几乎要昏过去。

sentences.en: And that was fine by me.
sentences.zh: 对此我并不介意。

sentences.en: I wanted them to have a little fear.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能有一点恐惧感。

sentences.en: Aaron Bacon's parents still feel that the adults involved in their son's death paid too small a price for their role in his demise.
sentences.zh: 亚伦·培根的父母仍然认为，导致他们儿子死亡的成年人所付出的代价太小了。

sentences.en: They have spoken out against Lance Jagger's assertion that he's providing tough love, with Sally Bacon telling ABC News,
sentences.zh: 他们公开反对兰斯·贾格尔关于他是在提供“严厉的爱”的说法，萨莉·培根告诉美国广播公司新闻部：

sentences.en: You can do tough love as a parent because you love the child.
sentences.zh: 作为父母，你可以实施严厉的爱，因为你爱这个孩子。

sentences.en: They can do tough.
sentences.zh: 他们能做到严厉。

sentences.en: They can't do love.
sentences.zh: 但他们做不到爱。

sentences.en: Police gave Sally and Bob their son's journal after they had copied its contents as evidence.
sentences.zh: 警方在复印了亚伦日记的内容作为证据后，将其交还给了萨莉和鲍勃。

sentences.en: The entries were painful for the couple to read as they detailed Aaron's physical decline in excruciating detail as well as his emotional pain.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇读着日记感到非常痛苦，因为日记里极其详尽地记录了亚伦身体状况的恶化以及他的情感痛苦。

sentences.en: Some pages were dotted with Aaron's blood.
sentences.zh: 有些页面上还点缀着亚伦的血迹。

sentences.en: But there were also lines that spoke of Aaron's love for his family.
sentences.zh: 但其中也有表达亚伦对家人爱意的文字。

sentences.en: In one early entry, he reflected on his goodbye before being taken into North Star and wrote,
sentences.zh: 在早期的一篇日记中，他反思了被带往“北极星”之前的告别，写道：

sentences.en: I should have told them that I love them and I'm sorry I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我本该告诉他们我爱他们，我很抱歉我没说。

sentences.en: I didn't even hug them and that was terrible.
sentences.zh: 我甚至没有拥抱他们，这太糟糕了。

sentences.en: I sure wish I could hug them and tell them I love them now.
sentences.zh: 我真希望现在能拥抱他们，告诉他们我爱他们。
